title: Where You End
voice_standard: Liam - warm brilliant friend at midnight; precise in the experiment, tender on the grief beat, expansive but careful on the tide metaphor, gentle on the invitation

scenes.text: Quick question. Where do you end?
scenes.semantic_anchor: A hand at the edge of lamplight, the rest in shadow.
scenes.query: hand reaches to edge of warm lamplight on dark table genuine movement

scenes.text: At your skin? Inside is you; outside is world.

scenes.text: Try one experiment.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A stopwatch beside a soft paintbrush as an experiment begins.
scenes.query: hand starts vintage stopwatch beside soft paintbrush on lit laboratory table macro motion

scenes.text: Hide your real hand. Place a rubber one where it should be.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A visibly artificial rubber hand rests on a table while the real hand is hidden behind a divider.
scenes.query: rubber hand illusion experiment real hand hidden behind divider visible rubber hand table

scenes.text: Stroke both in synchrony—the fake you see, the real one you feel.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Two brushes move in matched rhythm across visible and hidden hands.
scenes.query: two paintbrushes synchronously stroke visible rubber hand and hidden real hand laboratory motion

scenes.text: Soon, many people feel ownership. Threaten the rubber hand, and the body may react.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The complete rubber-hand experiment is unmistakable as a harmless threat approaches the artificial hand.

scenes.text: Careful conclusion: body ownership is flexible—a boundary revised by sensory evidence.

scenes.text: That working boundary can also reach outward.

scenes.query: single water ripple visibly spreads outward across dark lit surface slow motion

scenes.text: Tools can enter the brain's working map of near space.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Fingers move fluently across keys without looking.
scenes.query: fingers type fluently across keyboard without looking genuine hand and key motion macro

scenes.text: Now dim the lab lights—but keep the question.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A laboratory lamp dims into the warmer light of an ordinary room.
scenes.query: clinical desk lamp slowly dims as warm room lamp rises in background genuine light change

scenes.text: Close relationships can overlap with how the mind represents the self.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Two people are connected by fine threads of warm light without losing their separate outlines.

scenes.text: Maybe self is less fortress than tide: reaching and returning with contact.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A tide reaches up a dark shore and draws back.

scenes.text: You cannot command the tide, but you can choose where to reach.
scenes.semantic_anchor: An open hand reaches deliberately toward another without closing around it.
scenes.query: open hand reaches toward another hand in warm light without grabbing genuine movement

scenes.text: Practice, care, and boundaries influence what your life includes.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A person tends a living boundary where a garden opens into a broad landscape.
scenes.query: person tends low garden boundary opening toward wide dawn landscape genuine hand movement

scenes.text: Pull a boundary too tight, and protection can become isolation.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A figure closes a curtain against a living world outside, leaving a narrow seam of light.
scenes.query: person slowly closes curtain against rainy moving street leaving narrow seam warm light

scenes.text: Return to something ordinary: the warm cup in your hands.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Hands settle around a steaming cup in morning light.
scenes.query: hands settle around warm ceramic cup steam rises in bright morning room genuine motion

scenes.text: Touch it. Where is the seam between sensation, tool, memory, and you?
scenes.semantic_anchor: A fingertip meets the cup at the exact seam between body and object.
scenes.query: fingertip slowly touches warm ceramic cup rim water droplet macro morning light

scenes.text: What have you called 'not me' without testing it? Find your edge tonight. You may be less fixed.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A figure walks toward a warm horizon while the shoreline shifts beside them.
scenes.query: small figure walks beside shifting tide toward vast warm horizon dusk genuine motion
